newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Oct car output up 42.6 pct - industry.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Oct car output up 42.6 pct - industry.

text.p: Argentine carmakers produced a total of 31,993 vehicles in October, a 42.6 percent rise from October 1995 and a 14.2 increase from September, the industry association ADEFA said Wednesday.
In the 10 months to October, production increased 4.4 percent from the same period a year ago, ADEFA said in its monthly report.
Domestic sales were 33,347 units, 31.4 percent more than in October 1995 and 5.1 percent more than in September. In the January-October period, sales rose 7.9 percent from the same period in 1995.

Argentine carmakers exported 13,549 vehicles in October, a 277.8 percent rise on October 1995 and a 49.5 increase on September. In the 10 months to October exports grew 98.0 percent from the same period a year ago.
